propositions: A rejected tickets-branch auto-push succeeds locally and reports success while the commit remains unpushed, violating the store's contract that every write is shared immediately.
The rejection reason captured by git is discarded by an over-broad regex classifier, causing the warning to report only retry count, masking the actual failure reason.
The divergence signal PUSH_PENDING is computed only on explicit fsck invocation and is never re-announced by subsequent writes, allowing an unpushed backlog to grow silently for hours.
Ticket event payloads (comments with raw environment output) are never scanned for secrets on write, unlike code which is scanned by gitleaks at the review gate.
Policy rejections (hook declined, push protection, rate limit) are misclassified as non-fast-forward and retried futilely instead of being rejected terminally with the reason surfaced.
